title: Director of Finance
message:
Malcolm, we connected a while back and I never followed up, so let me do that now.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. A fresh cut processor at your volume is buying raw product year round, which means the winter months come from Mexico and Central America whether or not anyone calls it an import.

Does the currency side of that reach your desk at F&S, or does it stay with procurement?

Marcel

title: Chief Financial Officer
message:
Katie, we connected a while back and I never wrote, which I should have.

I handle FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Fifteen years as CFO of a Latin food business means you have watched the peso move through several cycles, and the ones that hurt are usually the ones where the buy was already committed.

Is that exposure something Bravo manages deliberately, or does it mostly sit in the purchase price?

Marcel

title: Controller
message:
Tiffanie, we connected a while back and I never followed up. Correcting that.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Coming out of audit into a company that has roughly doubled since you joined usually means the finance stack gets built while the volume is already moving, and currency is the piece that waits longest.

Has that come up yet at Cobblestone, or is it still ahead of you?

Marcel

title: Controller
message:
Luz, we connected a while back and I never followed up properly.

I handle FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Importing out of South America into Florida usually means the grower is paid on one calendar and the retailer pays you on another, and the rate moves in between.

Does that gap sit with you at Square One, or with the owners?

Marcel

title: Senior Accounting Manager
message:
Jose, we connected a while back and I never wrote. Fixing that.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Twenty five years at Pacific Trellis means you have closed a lot of months where the fruit came from Chile or Mexico and the exchange rate did something the budget did not expect.

Is that something you price in now, or still absorb?

Marcel

title: Chief Operating Officer
message:
Erica, we connected a while back and I never followed up.

I handle FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Owning both the produce side and the trucking side means you are paying Mexican growers and Mexican carriers out of the same US entity, which is two conversions most people only notice as one.

Is that handled in house at Galera, or through the bank?

Marcel

title: Chief Executive Officer
message:
Milca, conectamos hace tiempo y nunca le escribi, asi que lo hago ahora.

Llevo la parte de pagos internacionales y divisas en Monex USA. Al arrancar Munay en 2024 usted armo todo desde cero, y la parte cambiaria suele ser la ultima en definirse aunque el limon y el esparrago se paguen afuera desde el primer dia.

Ya quedo resuelto ese lado, o sigue pendiente?

Marcel

title: President
message:
Marden, we connected a while back and I never followed up, so let me do it now.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Running produce lanes with entities on both sides of the US and Canada border means the dollar leg gets settled constantly, and that rate rarely gets negotiated the way a freight rate does.

Does that sit with you directly at Etlas?

Marcel

title: Chairman and President
message:
Quay, we connected a while back and I never wrote. Correcting that.

I handle FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. Valves and IBOPs go wherever the rigs are, which means invoices in dollars to buyers whose own budget is in something else, and that tends to show up as pricing pressure rather than as a currency line.

Is international a big enough share at M&M for that to matter yet?

Marcel

title: Owner
message:
Steve, we connected a while back and I never followed up.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA, and I will be in El Paso in October. Running cross border loads out of El Paso usually means settling with carriers on the Juarez side from a US entity, and that conversion is easy to leave on autopilot for years.

How is that handled at 3Pete today?

Marcel

title: Founder and President
message:
Jorge, we connected a while back and I never followed up, so let me do it now.

I handle FX and cross border payments at Monex USA. A customs broker automating the brokerage side ends up holding client money in motion, and the currency leg is usually the one part still done by hand at whatever rate the bank offers that morning.

Is that something EXL touches, or do your clients settle it themselves?

Marcel

title: CEO and President
message:
Oswaldo, conectamos hace tiempo y nunca le escribi. Lo corrijo ahora, y mas siendo los dos de Houston.

Llevo la parte de pagos internacionales y divisas en Monex USA. Entre el Consulado y la representacion de Yucatan usted ha visto el comercio Mexico Estados Unidos desde los dos lados, asi que imagino que la parte cambiaria de sus clientes le aparece seguido.

Eso lo resuelven ustedes, o lo dejan al banco del cliente?

Marcel
